data.name: Jiyaul

data.long_meaning: The name Jiyaul is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jaya' (victory) and 'Laxmi' (goddess of wealth). This name represents the triumph of prosperity and abundance in one's life. The name Jiyaul carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jiyaul usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the divine blessing of abundance and prosperity.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jiyaul total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
